title: Remote Sensing Change Detection via Weak Temporal Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2601.02126v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Semantic change detection in remote sensing aims to identify land cover changes between bi-temporal image pairs. Progress in this area has been limited by the scarcity of annotated datasets, as pixel-level annotation is costly and time-consuming. To address this, recent methods leverage synthetic data or generate artificial change pairs, but transferring change detection models across datasets and acquisition conditions remains challenging. In this work, we introduce a weak temporal supervision strategy that leverages additional temporal observations of existing single-temporal datasets, without requiring any new annotations. Specifically, we extend single-date remote sensing datasets with new observations acquired at different times and train a change detection model by assuming that real bi-temporal pairs mostly contain no change, while pairing images from different locations to generate change examples. translated_title: 基于弱时间监督的遥感变化检测
translated_abstract: 遥感中的语义变化检测旨在识别双时相图像对之间的土地覆盖变化。由于像素级标注成本高昂且耗时，该领域的进展一直受限于标注数据集的稀缺。为解决这一问题，近期的方法利用合成数据或生成人工变化样本对，但在不同数据集和采集条件之间迁移变化检测模型仍然具有挑战性。在本工作中，我们提出了一种弱时间监督策略，该策略利用现有单时相数据集的额外时间观测数据，而无需任何新的标注。具体而言，我们通过在不同时间获取的新观测数据来扩展单时相遥感数据集，在训练变化检测模型时假设真实的双时相图像对大多不包含变化，同时将来自不同地点的图像进行配对以生成变化样本。为了处理固有的…
tldr: 该论文提出一种弱时间监督策略，通过为现有单时相遥感数据集补充不同时间的新观测数据，并假设真实双时相图像对大多无变化、以跨地点图像配对生成变化样本，从而在无需任何新标注的情况下训练遥感语义变化检测模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a weak temporal supervision strategy that trains remote sensing semantic change detection models without any new annotations, by augmenting existing single-temporal datasets with new temporal observations, assuming real bi-temporal pairs mostly contain no change, and pairing images from different locations to generate change examples.
